title: Blockchain Developer
jobDescription: About the Role We are looking for a Blockchain Developer who is passionate about building secure, scalable, and production-ready blockchain solutions while continuously exploring emerging technologies in the blockchain ecosystem. In this role, you will design and develop blockchain applications, smart contracts, and backend services across public and permissioned blockchain platforms. You will also conduct technical research to evaluate new blockchain technologies, security practices, interoperability solutions, privacy-preserving techniques, decentralized identity frameworks, and other advancements in the blockchain ecosystem, helping the team adopt the most suitable approaches for real-world applications. The ideal candidate enjoys both hands-on development and technical exploration and can translate research findings into practical, production-ready solutions Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain blockchain-based applications and backend services. Develop, test, deploy, and optimize smart contracts on public and permissioned blockchain networks. Build Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to evaluate new blockchain technologies, frameworks, and protocols. Research emerging areas such as: Smart contract security and auditing Cross-chain interoperability Privacy-preserving technologies (ZKP, MPC, etc.) Layer-2 scaling solutions Tokenization and digital asset infrastructure Decentralized Identity (DID/VC) Translate research outcomes into practical product features and architectural improvements. Integrate blockchain networks with enterprise applications and backend systems. Optimize blockchain applications for performance, scalability, security, and reliability. Participate in smart contract reviews, security assessments, and vulnerability analysis. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver blockchain-based products. Stay up to date with advances in blockchain protocols, developer tools, standards, and industry best practices, and share knowledge with the team. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field. 2-4 years of hands-on experience in blockchain application development. Experience developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining smart contracts on public or permissioned blockchain platforms. Experience working on blockchain-based products, enterprise blockchain solutions, or Web3 applications. Experience building Proofs of Concept (PoCs) or evaluating emerging blockchain technologies is highly desirable. Technical Skills Strong experience with blockchain platforms such as Ethereum, Polygon, Hyperledger (Fabric/Besu), Cosmos, or similar ecosystems. Proficiency in Solidity for smart contract development (Rust is a plus). Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals, including consensus mechanisms, transactions, Merkle trees, digital signatures, cryptographic hashing, and distributed systems. Proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Go, Python, Java, or Rust. Experience with Hardhat, Foundry, Web3 libraries, Ethers.js/Web3.js, or similar blockchain development frameworks. Familiarity with Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, Git, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Understanding of blockchain security best practices, smart contract auditing, and secure software development principles. Preferred Qualifications Prior research experience in blockchain technologies is desirable, particularly in areas such as smart contract security, interoperability, privacy-preserving technologies (ZKP/MPC), Layer-2 scaling, decentralized identity (DID/VC), or tokenization. Contributions to open-source blockchain projects, technical blogs, research publications, or blockchain communities are a plus. Familiarity with blockchain testing, benchmarking, and performance optimization techniques.

title: Linux Kernel Security Engineer
jobDescription: About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled Linux Kernel Security Engineer to join our cybersecurity defense research team. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a forward-looking security team focused on proactive threat mitigation, vulnerability research, and system integrity enhancement. Responsibilities System Security Research & Development Analyze historical and emerging Linux vulnerabilities (CVE research and impact assessment). Design and implement kernel-level monitoring and protection tools. Develop secure and efficient Linux Kernel Modules (LKMs) for detection and defense purposes. Research modern techniques for system integrity, syscall behavior analysis, and runtime protection. Security Engineering & Tooling Build low-level system utilities using C/C++ for security visibility and resilience. Enhance Linux infrastructure with custom security modules, syscall instrumentation, and auditing tools. Collaborate with infrastructure and DevSecOps teams to ensure secure system-level deployments. Risk Analysis & Hardening Evaluate system behavior under potential attack scenarios in a controlled and defensive context. Recommend mitigations for vulnerabilities in kernel space and userland boundaries. Support the implementation of hardening configurations and kernel security features such as SELinux, AppArmor, and seccomp. Documentation & Reporting Document technical findings, tools, and system modifications clearly and professionally. Create detailed reports for internal teams and contribute to secure development guidelines. Eligibility Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a related field. Postgraduate degree or relevant research experience is an added advantage. Technical Skills Strong understanding of Linux Kernel architecture, including: System call interface Process and memory management Filesystems and device drivers Strong proficiency in C and C++ for both kernel-space and user-space development. Experience with: Socket programming and Linux networking stack Kernel debugging tools such as gdb, ftrace, kprobes, and perf Building and maintaining Loadable Kernel Modules (LKMs) Security Experience Familiarity with Linux vulnerability analysis, CVE assessment, and secure coding practices. Understanding of kernel hardening techniques, mitigations, and runtime protections. Knowledge of threat modeling and defensive strategies at the operating system level. Desired Eligibility Certifications (Preferred) OSCP, OSEP, or equivalent advanced security certifications. LFD420 (Linux Kernel Internals – Linux Foundation). Additional Linux or security-focused certifications are a plus. Desirable Skills Experience with secure Linux deployment models. Knowledge of Mandatory Access Control (MAC) systems such as SELinux and AppArmor. Experience with container runtime security, including seccomp-bpf and namespaces. Contributions to open-source security tools or Linux kernel projects. Background in participating in security research communities or CTF platforms is preferred. title: SIEM Rule Engineer
jobDescription: About the Role The SIEM Rule Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and tuning detection rules, signatures, and alerts for SIEM, IDS/IPS, and other monitoring platforms. This role focuses on enhancing threat detection capabilities by translating threat intelligence, attack patterns, and security use cases into actionable and accurate detections. Responsibilities Rule Engineering & Detection Content Development Develop and maintain correlation rules, signatures, and detection logic in SIEM platforms such as Splunk, ELK, and QRadar, along with IDS/IPS tools such as Suricata and Snort, and EDR platforms such as Wazuh. Translate MITRE ATT&CK techniques into effective detection rules. Tune existing rules to reduce false positives and false negatives while improving detection accuracy. Implement YARA, Sigma, or custom detection formats based on platform requirements. Threat Intelligence Integration Collaborate with Threat Intelligence and Incident Response teams to operationalize Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs). Create enrichment pipelines using threat feeds such as STIX/TAXII, MISP, and similar platforms. SOC Automation & Optimization Integrate rule alerts with SOAR platforms to enable automated response workflows. Ensure all rules follow proper version control and documentation practices using tools such as Git. Conduct regression testing of detection rules during platform upgrades and updates. Monitoring & Analytics Continuously monitor and evaluate rule performance using telemetry and log data. Develop dashboards and reporting mechanisms for alert metrics, rule health, and detection coverage gaps. Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with blue teams, red teams, compliance teams, and application owners to refine detection use cases. Participate in purple teaming exercises and enhance rules based on post-attack simulations and findings. Eligibility Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in a SOC, cyber threat detection, or security engineering role. Proficiency in writing SIEM rules, Suricata/Snort signatures, or similar detection logic. Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and threat modeling methodologies. Hands-on experience with ELK Stack, Splunk, QRadar, or equivalent SIEM platforms. Familiarity with log sources such as Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, Zeek, Suricata, and firewall logs. Desired Eligibility Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python or Bash for custom log parsing and enrichment. Experience with SOAR platforms such as Cortex XSOAR and Splunk SOAR. Experience with industrial protocols for OT environments, including Modbus, DNP3, and S7Comm. Exposure to cloud logging and detection platforms such as AWS CloudTrail and Azure Sentinel. Relevant certifications such as GCIA, GCED, GCTD, Splunk Certified, or Elastic Certified Analyst are preferred. title: System Engineer (DevOps)/DevOps Engineer – On-Premise Infrastructure
jobDescription: We run our platform entirely on our own on-premise servers. There are no cloud-managed services behind the scenes. When something fails, we investigate it, understand it, and fix it ourselves. We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer who is comfortable working closely with Kubernetes, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, general networking, and Linux systems in a fully self-managed environment. Comfortable working daily with kubectl , with clear knowledge of Kubernetes internals to effectively trace, diagnose, and resolve production problems. You should also be comfortable working primarily through the command line , as there are no UI buttons to resolve most issues, this role requires getting hands-on and working directly with the system when needed. This role suits someone who enjoys debugging real problems, reading documentations, patiently tracing what went wrong, explaining the root cause clearly, and putting in place long-term fixes instead of temporary patches. More than anything, this role values ownership, curiosity, clear thinking, documentation, and steady improvement over time . Core Responsibilities: Running and caring for on-prem Kubernetes clusters across internal and client environments. Keeping self-hosted GitLab, runners, CI/CD pipelines, and container registries reliable and predictable. Troubleshooting real production issues across containers, networking, storage, CI/CD, and Linux systems. This requires command line shell experience. Performing thoughtful root cause analysis , sharing clear explanations, and implementing fixes that last. Supporting multiple client clusters together with the DevOps team and helping maintain their stability. Working with Linux administration, internal networking, certificates, access control, and service communication in on-prem setups. Noticing repetitive manual work and gradually replacing it with automation or simple tooling . Using tools like Ansible, Terraform, or similar when they genuinely make operations easier. Maintaining monitoring, logging, and alerting so problems are visible before they grow. Writing and updating runbooks, architecture notes, recovery steps, and operational documentation that others can rely on. Helping with deployments, releases, and incident response , including occasional on-call support. Continuously improving reliability, performance, and operational clarity of the platform. Staying curious about useful new practices in Kubernetes, security, and infrastructure , and applying them thoughtfully. Required Experience Around 3+ years of real hands-on work in DevOps or infrastructure. Practical comfort with on-prem Kubernetes , including failures and recovery. Solid understanding of Linux systems, basic networking, and step-by-step debugging . Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Docker, and container lifecycle workflows . Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools . Ability to analyze issues calmly and explain root causes clearly . Some scripting ability in Bash, Python, or similar . Habit of documenting what you build, change, and fix . Exposure to ingress, load balancing, or service mesh in Kubernetes. Experience with automation tools like Ansible, Terraform, or similar and know how to use them end to end. Personal Qualities Someone who genuinely enjoys debugging and understanding systems deeply . Comfortable working where everything is self-managed and visible . Able to take ownership quietly and follow problems through to resolution . Prefers long-term stability and automation over quick temporary fixes. Keeps clear notes and documentation for the team. Stays curious and keeps learning , step by step. Works well with others, while also being able to handle things independently when needed . Travel Occasional travel may be needed for on-prem client deployments, troubleshooting, or coordination .
